gas_costs.note: Corrected 2026-08-20 after the fact -- deploy.sh's original run of this deployment reported grand_total_eth as a flat 0 due to two bugs (fixed in scripts/deploy.sh: an activation-tx-hash regex that didn't match cargo-stylus 0.10.7's unprefixed hash format, and a subshell variable-scoping bug that discarded the running total). verifier_module/storage_contract's activation tx hashes could not be recovered after the fact (the deployer's nonce sequence places them at nonces 1 and 3-6, but block-scanning the public RPC to find them by nonce got rate-limited: HTTP 403). logic_contract's activation was recoverable from the run's own printed log output. grand_total_eth below is the AUTHORITATIVE real total, confirmed directly from the deployer wallet's balance delta (0xF879bf165eA8396b1164e842f9DC21442da29a62: 0.006 ETH before, ~0.0048025 ETH after) -- trust this over summing the individual per-step figures, since verifier_module/storage_contract's activate_gas below are known-incomplete (missing their activation cost, folded into the ~0.0008764 ETH gap between the summed known components and this real total).

notes: storage_contract is the stable protocol identifier — never redeployed.
